sources.name: CMS Nursing Home Provider Information

coverage.universe: Currently active Medicare/Medicaid-certified nursing homes (one row per provider)

sources.name: CMS Health Deficiencies
sources.primary_identifier: CCN + Survey Date + Deficiency Prefix + Deficiency Tag Number

coverage.universe: Health citations from the three most recent standard surveys and complaint / infection-control inspections in the prior three years

known_limitations: Lookback is rolling: older cycles leave the file, so absence of an old citation is not evidence it never happened.
Statement-of-deficiency narratives are not in the dataset.

sources.name: California CDPH Licensed and Certified Healthcare Facility Listing
sources.publisher: California Department of Public Health (CDPH), Center for Health Care Quality, Licensing & Certification

coverage.universe: Every California skilled nursing facility and intermediate care facility (excluding developmental-disability ICFs) licensed by CDPH, certified or not

known_limitations: Harvest keeps facility types SNF and ICF only; the listing also covers hospitals, clinics and ICF-DD homes. ICFs run by the Department of State Hospitals (psychiatric / forensic) are excluded in the adapter.

Administrator names and contact emails are in the source but are not published by Carefield.

sources.name: California CDPH Health Facilities State Enforcement Actions (1997–2024, archived)
sources.publisher: California Department of Public Health (CDPH), Licensing & Certification

coverage.universe: State citations and administrative penalties issued to California SNFs and ICFs, 1997 through early 2024

known_limitations: CDPH archived this dataset; actions after early 2024 are only on CDPH's State Enforcement Actions dashboard and are not included.
State citations are separate from federal CMS deficiencies; the same event can produce both.

Classes: AA = violation was a direct proximate cause of a patient's death; A = imminent danger or substantial probability of death or serious harm; B = direct or immediate relationship to patient health, safety or security.
